Project ICARUS
should this plant be built? — answered in seconds.

A developer arrives with a site, a solar size, a battery size and a grid connection. ICARUS takes those inputs and returns a complete, defensible investment answer — built from a full year of hourly market behaviour, not a rule of thumb.

ICARUS — the platform in full. Every parameter on the left is adjustable; the entire case re-solves.click to enlarge

01 — THE CONFLICTThree revenues, one battery

Every hour, the same stored megawatt-hour can be sold into day-ahead arbitrage, committed to Frequency Containment Reserve, or used to shift solar into a better price window. Commit it to one and you forfeit the others. Most feasibility studies pick a favourite; ICARUS resolves the trade-off explicitly.

02 — THE METHODOptimised hour by hour, for a full year

An optimisation engine sizes the reserve bid and schedules charge, discharge and export against real German day-ahead prices, solar irradiance and grid frequency data. It solves day by day across an entire year, so the result reflects how the market actually behaved — including the days that lose money.

03 — THE ANSWERScalable to any configuration

Nothing here is hard-coded to one project. Change the PV capacity, battery power and duration, grid limit or reserve win rate, and the model re-solves and returns the investment picture for that configuration — cost stack, revenue split, degradation and replacement timing included.

On the figures in the screenshot — they belong to one example configuration and are shown to illustrate the kind of output the tool produces, not as a claim about any particular project. Change the inputs and every number above changes with them.

Tool 01 · Microsoft Excel

Interactive cost estimation & bidding dashboard

The problem. Every quotation was rebuilt by hand — ex-works cost, inflation over the supply period, freight priced by weight and dangerous-goods class, transformation labour, packing and export — and the margin was guessed at the end, under time pressure.

What it does. Enter one RFQ row and it lands a defensible offer price. Four margin scenarios compute side by side, so a salesperson can see immediately what a 15% versus a 40% gross margin does to competitiveness before committing to a number in front of the customer.

Costing inputs on the left, pricing and margin scenarios on the right, business performance top-rightclick to enlarge
Tool 02 · Power BI

Business KPI dashboard

The problem. Sales, invoicing and procurement each lived in a different system. The monthly picture was assembled by hand, days after the point at which it could have changed a decision.

What it does. One screen for the whole department — top accounts and products, invoicing planned against achieved per account holder, progress toward target, and procurement split by shortage, stock and payment status, so blocked orders surface before they become late deliveries.

Selected Work

More, if you want the range

Microgrid optimisation, a commercial PV and battery design, and three thermodynamic cycle models built from first principles.

Master's project · Python · oemof · Linear programming

Self-sustained microgrid sizing and investment optimisation

Nine households with a heat demand and an electricity demand, and a shopping list of assets: roof and ground PV, battery, heat pump, thermal store, electrolyser, hydrogen storage, fuel cell, plus a diesel genset and boiler as backup. Linear programming picks the size of every component.

The interesting part is that "optimal" depends entirely on what you minimise. I ran three cases — an ecological one that drives CO₂ down at more than triple the cost of energy, an economical one that does the reverse, and the optimum between them, which is the one worth actually building.

Applied design project · Polysun

Rooftop PV & battery for a NORMA supermarket

A full design cycle for a 143 kWp flat-roof installation: hourly load profiling of every refrigeration, HVAC and lighting circuit in the store, yield and energy-flow simulation, module and inverter selection, mounting and shading layout, and battery sizing chosen from the minimum and maximum generation months rather than an annual average.

Closed out with a 30-year economic and ecological appraisal — including the energy payback of the hardware itself, which lands inside a year.

Simulation of Energy Systems · Excel · CoolProp · VBA

Three thermodynamic cycles, built from scratch

No black-box software. Every state point is computed from live CoolProp property tables, with VBA macros driving the iterative solving, what-if studies and chart automation behind each diagram.

01 — Combined cycle power plant
22.5% system efficiency · optimal pressure ratio 18.6

Brayton and Rankine cycles coupled through a heat recovery steam generator, with combustion chemistry and pressure-ratio optimisation curves solved iteratively.

02 — Solar organic Rankine cycle
20 kW net · R134a · 800 W/m²

Working-fluid selection across three refrigerants, T–s and TQ diagrams, and what-if analysis across the solar field.

03 — Brine–water heat pump
COP 3.96 · R410A · 46 kW supplied

Full cycle design with log(P)–h and T–s diagrams, checked against the real Danfoss compressor operating envelope.
